sanskrit: dūrād bheṣajam ābhṛtaṃ bahūny ati yojanā | apaśyam asyantaṃ rudraṃ na dṛṣṭo duṣkṛtaṃ karat ||
english: A remedy has been brought from afar, passing over many leagues. I saw Rudra shooting [his shafts]; when seen, let him not inflict harm on the wrongdoer.

sanskrit: bhinadmi te parāvato vatsasya śepyām iva | vṛṣed aso yathā mayi kṛṣṇo viṣāṇavām̐ iva ||
english: I split open the distant [fastening] of you as one splits a calf's tether. Be potent toward me as the dark, horned bull.

sanskrit: sarvā gāvaḥ saṃmanasaḥ sacchavayaḥ sanābhayaḥ | samānaṃ bibhratīr nāma vatsā ud rihatāṃ mithaḥ ||
english: May all the cows be of one mind, dwelling together, sharing the same nave. Bearing a common name, let the calves lick each other.

sanskrit: indras tvāgre avānayat savitā tvotāparaḥ | tṛtīyam aśvinā tvāghnye vāñcha ||
english: Indra led you down first; Savitṛ aided you next. Thirdly, O fire-woman [cow], the Aśvins [led you]; come!

sanskrit: ā te nayatu savit- -ā nayatu bṛhaspatiḥ | patir yaḥ pratikāmyas tam asyai dhehy oṣadhe ||
english: May Savitṛ lead him to you, may Bṛhaspati lead him. O herb, set upon this woman the husband who is to be desired.

sanskrit: indraṃ vayam anurādham ity ekā ||
english: "We follow Indra, the Anurādha [star]" — this is one [verse, cited by its opening words].

sanskrit: bhaga prehi prathamo 'nu tvā vayam emasi | indrāgnī brahmaṇāsmān svasti nayatāṃ pathā ||
english: O Bhaga, go forth first; we come after you. May Indra and Agni, through the sacred word, lead us safely on the path.

sanskrit: aditiḥ praitu prathamā bṛhaspatiḥ puraetā te astu | indro bhayaṃ vy asyatu śūdrāc ca na āryāc ca ||
english: Let Aditi go forth first; let Bṛhaspati be your vanguard. May Indra drive away fear for us — from the Śūdra and from the Ārya alike.

sanskrit: ime ye anasi yuktā uṣṭārā uta pīlvā | teṣāṃ sam agrabhaṃ padaḥ sam īrmān sam u sakthyaḥ ||
english: These [animals] yoked to the cart — the camels and the elephants — I have bound together their feet, their haunches, and their thighs as well.

sanskrit: vi madhyamā aproṣata gardabhā kṣipitā iva | athāsurasya māyayā mayīdaṃ sthāpayāmasi ||
english: The middle [ones] among the donkeys ran apart like those struck by frenzy. Then by the Asura's magic power we establish this [spell] in me.

sanskrit: saṃ mā bhagena dviguṇena varcasā saṃ mā pṛthivyā saṃ mauṣadhībhiḥ | saṃ māpo mayobhuvo bhagena varcasā sican ||
english: Unite me with twofold prosperity and radiance; unite me with the earth and with the plants. Let the beneficial waters sprinkle me together with prosperity and radiance.

sanskrit: varco me mitrāvaruṇety ekā ||
english: "O Mitra-Varuṇa, [give] me radiance" — this is one [verse, cited by its opening words].

sanskrit: ṛcaṃ sāma yajāmahe yābhyāṃ karmāṇi kṛṇvate | vi te sadasi rājato yajñaṃ deveṣu yacchatām ||
english: We worship the ṛc and the sāman, by means of which rites are performed. May they, shining in their seat, extend the sacrifice among the gods.

sanskrit: aṅgamaṅgaṃ saṃ cinomi cakṣuḥ prāṇam atho balam | priyāḥ śrutasya bhūyāsm- -āyuṣmantaḥ sumedhasaḥ ||
english: Limb by limb I build up [the body]: eye, breath, and also strength. May we be dear through [sacred] learning, long-lived and of good understanding.

sanskrit: etan no deva savitar jagaddhātrī ca rakṣatam | pūṣainat punar ājatv avinaṣṭam avihrutam ||
english: O divine Savitṛ, and you who sustain the world, protect us. May Pūṣan drive it back again — unbroken, undispersed.

sanskrit: yāvanty eva palitāni sākaṃ jajñire agraśaḥ | tebhyaḥ pari bravīmi tvā kṛṣṇāḥ keśā bhavantu me ||
english: As many grey hairs as have appeared together, sprouting from the tips — from them I speak around you: may my hairs be black.

sanskrit: kṛṣṇān keśān sinīvāli kṛṣṇān keśān sarasvati | kṛṣṇān me aśvinā keśān kṛṇutaṃ puṣkarasrajā ||
english: O Sinīvālī, make my hairs black; O Sarasvatī, make my hairs black. O Aśvins garlanded with lotuses, make my hairs black.

sanskrit: ado yad agre devānāṃ purastād avatiṣṭhati | tan me +'bravīt tvaṣṭā viriṣṭabheṣajam ||
english: That which stands yonder before the gods in the east — that Tvaṣṭṛ declared to me as the remedy for what is broken.

sanskrit: śvā viśvadhāyasā viśvabheṣajyā kṛtam | yad āmayati niṣ kṛdhi niṣkṛtir nāma vā asi ||
english: What is done by the dog with all-nourishing, all-healing power — whatever ails [one], drive it out; for you are indeed named Deliverance.

sanskrit: saṃ te cṛtāmi takariṃ saṃ yoniṃ saṃ gavīnyau | saṃ mātaraṃ ca putraṃ ca saṃ garbhaṃ ca jarāyu ca ||
english: I join together your birth-passage, I join together your womb, I join together your birth-canals. I join together mother and child, and I join together the embryo and the afterbirth.

sanskrit: tiryaṅ te garbho bhavatu hṛdayasthaṃ jarāyu te | ād oṣam agnim ā roh- -ād gaccha yamasādanam ||
english: Let your embryo lie transverse; let your afterbirth be lodged at the heart. Then mount the consuming fire — go to the abode of Yama.

sanskrit: vi te cṛtāmi takariṃ vi yoniṃ vi gavīnyau | vi mātaraṃ ca putraṃ ca vi garbhaṃ ca jarāyu ca ||
english: I rend asunder your birth-passage, I rend asunder your womb, I rend asunder your birth-canals. I rend asunder mother from child, and I rend asunder the embryo and the afterbirth.

sanskrit: anvaṅ te garbho bhavatv anusota jarāyu te | yathā tvaṃ putraṃ vindāsai yathā jīvāsi bhadrayā ||
english: Let your embryo follow along the right way; let your afterbirth flow in sequence. So that you may obtain a son, so that you may live in good fortune.

sanskrit: pra pṛṣṭhe garbham ardaya vi yona āsyaṃ sṛja | nir aitu daśamāsyo garbho gavīnyor adhi ||
english: Press the embryo forward along the back; release the opening of the womb. Let the ten-month embryo come forth from the birth-canals.

sanskrit: viṣkambheṇa vi ṣkabhāya tau viṣvañcau vyākuru | eṣa vām agnir antarā sa viṣvañcau vy asyatu ||
english: With a prop, prop them apart; spread those two asunder in opposite directions. This fire between you two — let it drive those two apart in opposite directions.

sanskrit: viṣkambho vi ṣkabhāyatu manaś ca hṛdayaṃ ca vām | vivartana vartaya śaśvatībhyaḥ samābhyaḥ ||
english: Let the prop prop apart your mind and your heart. O Revolving One, turn [them] away for all the years to come.

sanskrit: samudraṃ tvā pra hiṇomi svāṃ yonim apīhi | acchidras tanvā bhūyāsaṃ mā parā seci me payaḥ ||
english: I send you off to the ocean; return to your own womb. May I be whole in body; let not my milk be spilled away.

sanskrit: yad atrāpi rasasya me parāpapātāsmṛtam | tad ihopa hvayāmahe tan mā pyāyatāṃ punaḥ ||
english: Whatever of my essence has here slipped away, forgotten — that we call back hither; let that swell up in me again.

sanskrit: kavir agre pra lilekha dhartā keśām̐ adhārayat | ihaiva viśvato dadhad dhātā tvaṣṭā tvaci keśām̐ acīkl̥pat ||
english: The seer first inscribed [the design]; the upholder fixed the hairs in place. Placing [them] here on all sides, the creator Tvaṣṭṛ implanted the hairs in the skin.

sanskrit: sarasvati vrateṣu te divyeṣu devi dhāmasu | mandre hiraṇyavartane pra ṇa āyūṃṣi tāriṣaḥ ||
english: O Sarasvatī, O goddess, in your divine observances and in your celestial abodes — you who are joyful, moving on a golden path — extend our life-spans forth.
